Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Whipstitch Edge Decorative Throw Pillow, 18" x 18", Light Grey with White Whipstitch
Colors: Light Gray With White Whipstitch
Look closely: This seemingly solid light grey pillow actually has a subtle plaid of burnt siena thread. Whip-stitching around the edges gives it a clean, crisp look. This pillow is versatile enough to blend with any style bedding. 18" x 18" 75% Polyester, 15% Cotton, 10% Lycra Polyester fiber-filled insert Made in India Brush, vacuum or spot clean with damp white cloth and allow to air dry
